collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2016 - 2019 (W213) requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this E Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
